decisions.reason: As a flagship click-in adapter that is integral to the firm's track system, it supports the core offer and meets aspirations in a growing industry, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

This LED luminaire line sits close to the established range and was only mentioned on the site, so it may be refreshed, but with industry growth and adequate slack, keeping it is the satisficing choice.
Home automation hardware ages quickly and the evidence on its results is thin, but it complements the firm's control and automation strategy and slack allows the firm to carry it for now.
The luminaire family had its own page in 2018, which suggests reasonable standing within the core range, and there is no sign of a performance shortfall that would justify dropping it.
